# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Passkey Access

Gives apps on Windows access to passkeys, so that signing in with a passkey works in apps and in a remote session (Windows App, Azure Virtual Desktop) without the user having to turn on the privacy setting themselves.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Device config |
| Assignment | All Devices |
| Source | Own baseline — OMA-URI ./Device/Vendor/MSFT/Policy/Config/Privacy/LetAppsAccessPasskeys = 1 (Force allow), Policy CSP Privacy. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Passkey_Access.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Passkey_Access.json) |

> Custom profile (OMA-URI): the setting is not in the Settings Catalog yet. Microsoft documents it for Windows Insider Preview; if a build does not know it, Intune reports an error for this setting and nothing changes. Force allow also locks the per-app list; to deny one app anyway, use LetAppsAccessPasskeys_ForceDenyTheseApps.
